name: Niels Birk
role: The father. Blacksmith, foreman at Rekord

known.fact: Blacksmith, ex-motorcycle racer, foreman at the Rekord machine factory, contracted to repair the dam contractor's machines.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: When an informer comes asking about his son he says the boy is on a course in Copenhagen.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

invented: The research notes say he was "forced to work for the Nazis". The scanned pages only say he had a repair contract with the Danish dam contractor. Decide whether we keep the invented version.
